selection_process: The selection process comprises the following stages:
Scrutiny of online applications based on age

and other criteria. For Project Scientific Officer & Project Scientific Assistant (Post Code 01 & 02): Selection is solely based upon performance in personal interview. A written test may be conducted for screening purpose only

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal via the Institute's website: https://www.ipr.res.in/opportunities/current-opening-recruitment.
Fill in personal, educational, and reservation particulars carefully in the online application form.

Pay the application fee through SBI Collect portal (https://sbcollect.sbi.bank.in/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm) by selecting category "Automobiles/Fuel", searching "Institute for Plasma Research", Gujarat, selecting payment category "Application fees-IPR", and entering the Advertisement No. (08/2026) and Post Code in the Remarks field.
Download and save the SBI Collect payment receipt, and enter the payment and transaction details in the online application form.

Upload a recent passport size colour photograph and scanned copies of supporting documents (proof of age, mark sheets/certificates, caste/community certificate if applicable, experience certificates).
Submit the completed online application by 16-11-2026 (till 5:30 PM). There is no need to send hard copies of the application or supporting documents.
In case of any issue in filing the online application, contact [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IPR Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 58 temporary vacancies have been advertised across 10 post codes and branches.

content_sections.heading: IPR Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The eligibility of all candidates in all respects including age and qualification is determined with reference to 16-11-2026. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. All qualifications must be from UGC recognized Indian Universities / AICTE approved Institute or Board only. Applicants with qualifications from foreign countries must submit an equivalency certificate from UGC / AIU. For the Project Scientific Assistant posts, only candidates holding a three-year Diploma will be considered. Candidates possessing higher qualification than the ONE prescribed for Post Code 01 & 02 will be treated as over qualified for the advertised post and will not be screened in.

rows.qualification_required: B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 60% marks
B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science / Engineering with minimum 60% marks
B.E./B.Tech. in Instrumentation & Control / Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 60% marks
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (three-year Diploma) with minimum 60% marks
Diploma in Electrical Engineering (three-year Diploma) with minimum 60% marks
Diploma in Electronics / Electronics & Communication Engineering (three-year Diploma) with minimum 60% marks
Diploma in Instrumentation & Control / Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering (three-year Diploma) with minimum 60% marks
Diploma in Computer Science / Engineering (three-year Diploma) with minimum 60% marks
Graduate in Arts/ Commerce / Management/ Science/ Law /Computer Application with minimum 50% marks and Certified Course in Computer

content_sections.heading: IPR Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated with reference to 16-11-2026. Age relaxation is admissible to SC / ST / OBC / PwBD / Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government of India orders on the subject from time to time.

content_sections.heading: IPR Salary 2026
content_sections.text: In addition to the remuneration mentioned above, Medical Scheme facility under Contributory Health Service Scheme – CHSS facility (self only) is admissible, and necessary deductions will be made every month from salary/remuneration as per IPR CHSS rules. The official notification does not mention the in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: IPR Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Application fee must be paid through online mode only via SBI Collect. Candidates claiming fee exemption must submit the relevant certificate, failing which their candidature will not be considered. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstance nor held in reserve.

content_sections.heading: IPR Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises the following stages: Scrutiny of online applications based on age, educational qualification, category certificate, fee receipt, and other criteria. For Project Scientific Officer & Project Scientific Assistant (Post Code 01 & 02): Selection is solely based upon performance in personal interview. A written test may be conducted for screening purpose only, if required. For Project Administrative Staff (Post Code 03): Selection is based on written test and computer skill test.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A recent passport size colour photograph. Proof of age: Date of Birth as recorded in Birth Certificate, Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC), or Matriculation / Secondary School Certificate mentioning DOB. Educational mark sheets, certificates, and degrees. Experience certificate(s), if any. Certificate of caste/community/class in prescribed Govt. of India format (for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/PwBD/EWS/Ex-Serviceman candidates), if applicable. Equivalency certificate from UGC/AIU for applicants with foreign qualifications. Any other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total vacancy count in IPR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 58 temporary vacancies across Project Scientific Officer, Project Scientific Assistant, and Project Administrative Staff posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for IPR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 16 November 2026 up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IPR posts?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General and OBC candidates, while SC, ST, Female, PwBD, EWS, and Ex-Serviceman candidates are exempt from payment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IPR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 16-11-2026 is 40 years for Project Scientific Officer, 35 years for Project Scientific Assistant, and 30 years for Project Administrative Staff.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated salary offered for IPR project posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration including HRA is Rs. 72,930/- for Project Scientific Officer, Rs. 46,020/- for Project Scientific Assistant, and Rs. 25,870/- for Project Administrative Staff.

faq.question: Q6. Are the posts under IPR Recruitment 2026 permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: All posts are purely temporary in nature for a maximum period of three years, subject to annual performance reviews.

faq.question: Q7. Are candidates possessing higher qualifications eligible for Project Scientific Officer and Assistant posts?
faq.answer: No, candidates possessing qualifications higher than the one prescribed for Post Code 01 and 02 will be treated as over-qualified and will not be screened in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Scientific Officer and Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Selection is solely based upon performance in the interview, though a written test may be conducted for screening purposes if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any written exam for Project Administrative Staff?
faq.answer: Yes, selection for Project Administrative Staff (Post Code 03) will be based on a written test and a computer skill test.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the written test and interview take place?
faq.answer: The written test and / or interview will be conducted in Ahmedabad / Gandhinagar, Gujarat, and no travel allowance (TA) will be paid.
